That middle-of-the-pack box leaves some room on early downs, but DAL must block the front seven rather than count on light boxes. Overall, SF ranks 6th in EPA allowed per play [dc13] on 480 plays [dc14], with a 43.5% success rate allowed [dc15] on 480 plays [dc16]. DAL's offense posts 0.10 EPA per play [dc17] on 581 plays [dc18] and a 44.1% run success rate [dc19] on 213 runs [dc20], so it can keep moving the chains against this unit. The soft spot is third down, where SF allows conversions on 40.8% of attempts [dc21] over 103 plays [dc22], 19th in the league [dc23]. Red zone is a 48.0% TD rate allowed [dc24] on just 25 drives [dc25], 8th-best, but that is a small sample. DAL should attack third down with its best short-yardage and intermediate targets, and treat the red-zone numbers cautiously.
